rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System
Generation Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: G-042-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical parts of the generator
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station

This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the mechanical parts of the generator. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abdel Salam Abdel Hamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, approved by Eng. Abdel Karim Mousa Ahmed, Manager of the Mechanical Maintenance Department at the station, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and Coordinator of the Maintenance Procedures Information System.
Issue an approved work order; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, such as wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Make sure the work area is defined and the appropriate warning signs are put up
Make sure the unit is stopped and put in maintenance mode
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment
Suitable tool bag, tools for cleaning the filters
Inspect the lubricating lines
Clean the filters of the high-pressure pump
Clean the filters of the bearing lubricating circuit
Inspect the oil coolers
Test a sample of the oil used for bearing lubrication
Visually inspect the lubricating pumps, the pressure pump and the oil vapour extraction fan
Check the operation of the heaters in the lower and upper tanks
Inspect the oil flow indicators for all the bearings
Check the oil levels in the unit lubricating oil tank
Inspect the generator air cooling water lines
Wash the generator air coolers
Inspect the cooling fans
Grease the generator air cooling pumps for each unit
Inspect the brake jacks and test their operation
Inspect the brake air lines
Inspection and cleaning work on the generator is carried out in accordance with the outage programmes of the station's main equipment

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Generation Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: G-042-r0a | Equipment: Mechanical parts of the generator
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the mechanical parts of the generator. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abdel Salam Abdel Hamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, approved by Eng. Abdel Karim Mousa Ahmed, Manager of the Mechanical Maintenance Department at the station, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and Coordinator of the Maintenance Procedures Information System. | 
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card | 
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, such as wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc. | 
Make sure the work area is defined and the appropriate warning signs are put up | 
Make sure the unit is stopped and put in maintenance mode | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment | 
Suitable tool bag, tools for cleaning the filters | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
Inspect the lubricating lines | 1.
Clean the filters of the high-pressure pump | 2.
Clean the filters of the bearing lubricating circuit | 3.
Inspect the oil coolers | 4.
Test a sample of the oil used for bearing lubrication | 5.
Visually inspect the lubricating pumps, the pressure pump and the oil vapour extraction fan | 6.
Check the operation of the heaters in the lower and upper tanks | 7.
Inspect the oil flow indicators for all the bearings | 8.
Check the oil levels in the unit lubricating oil tank | 9.
Inspect the generator air cooling water lines | 10.
Wash the generator air coolers | 11.
Inspect the cooling fans | 12.
Grease the generator air cooling pumps for each unit | 13.
Inspect the brake jacks and test their operation | 14.
Inspect the brake air lines | 15.
Inspection and cleaning work on the generator is carried out in accordance with the outage programmes of the station's main equipment | 16.
